content: No dedicated library for 'peer divergence' (which group member diverges). Standard approach is a simple statistical computation: per-timestamp, compute group consensus (mean/median across members) then per-member deviation (z-score or MAD-based robust z-score) from that consensus; flag the member(s) exceeding threshold. This is directly implementable with numpy/scipy, reusing PyOD's existing MAD detector logic already in the codebase applied per-member against the cross-sectional group stat rather than each member's own history. No new dependency required.
